name: Copilot for Obsidian
description: Obsidian plugin that runs agents over your vault for research, writing and knowledge work.
whatItDoes: Adds chat and agent modes to Obsidian that can read notes, use tools, create files and work over several turns under permissions you set. It is for people who keep their knowledge base in Obsidian.
howItWorks: The plugin's Agent mode drives opencode, Claude Code or Codex from inside Obsidian, while Quick Chat talks to a model through your own API key or a local model. It is installed from Obsidian's Community Plugins. Multi-agent requests and Copilot-hosted models need a paid Plus plan.

requirements.name: LLM provider or agent account
requirements.description: An API key, a local model, or an existing Claude Code or Codex account

models: Bring-your-own API keys, local models, or Claude Code / Codex / opencode agents
